# Small Business Superannuation Clearing House

The SBSCH closed 1 July 2026 and is no longer available.

**Last updated** 16 July 2026

Print or Download

## The SBSCH closed 1 July 2026

The Small Business Superannuation Clearing House (SBSCH) closed permanently from 1 July 2026 as part of the [Payday Super](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers) reform. It can no longer be used to make payments or download records.

Super guarantee contributions for the quarter ending 30 June 2026 remain due on 28 July 2026. As the SBSCH will no longer be available, you should make these payments through an alternative method of payment. If you do not meet this date, you will need to lodge a super guarantee statement and pay the super guarantee charge to us.

If your payment was received on time but subsequently refunded to you, you will not be able to claim a deduction for it in the 2025–26 year.

## Alternatives to the SBSCH

Check your existing payroll software, as it may already include super functions you can use to pay your employees' super guarantee. Alternatively, you can look for payroll software and service providers in our [Super Product RegisterExternal Link](https://softwaredevelopers.ato.gov.au/SuperStream-certifiedproductregister).

Some large super funds may also have online payment services you can use, or you could use a commercial Clearing House.

For information on alternative payment methods see [SuperStream for employers](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/super-for-employers/paying-super-on-payday/superstream-for-employers).
